name: New York New Jersey Stadium (MetLife Stadium)
accessibility_features: Elevators at NE and SE corners, plus west side
Sensory rooms available at Section 111 and Section 233
Audio descriptive commentary via FIFA ADC app
Step-free access from Lot G via Gate A ramp

name: Mexico City Stadium (Estadio Azteca)
match_context: FIFA World Cup 2026 — Opening Match venue, June 11, 2026
accessibility_features: Accessible parking zones near Gate 1 and Gate 15
Ramp access to lower bowl from all cardinal gates
Metro Estadio Azteca station has elevator access
Accessible restrooms at every concourse level

name: Dallas Stadium (AT&T Stadium)
match_context: FIFA World Cup 2026 — Semifinal venue, July 14-15, 2026
accessibility_features: ADA-compliant entrances at all gates (A through H)
Assistive listening devices at Guest Services (Gate A, Gate E)
Wheelchair-accessible seating in all price tiers
Service animal relief areas at Gate D and Gate G plazas
